portal: Planes receding: the page you are on, the sessions behind it, the one lit at the bottom.
strata: A window onto conversation that runs past its edges — you see part of a larger world.
aperture: An iris: an instrument for looking, held open on something.
horizon: A round port; the strata pass behind it, unbounded by it.
fork: A session and the branch taken out of it — the topology `tree` draws.
thread: One conversation as one line, turning back on itself, still going.
stack: Sessions as planes seen edge-on, the current one lit.
dialogue: Turns, alternating: what was asked, what came back.
brackets: Code held open around the moment inside it.
cursor: A window with writing in it, still going.
